## Test Summary

Story types per `.claude/docs/coding-standards.md §Testing Standards`:

- **Logic** — formula / state-machine / pure-data. BLOCKING automated unit test required.
- **Integration** — multi-system / cross-plugin. BLOCKING automated test required.
- **Visual/Feel** — appearance / animation / VFX. ADVISORY screenshot + lead sign-off; not auto-closed by tests alone.
- **UI** — menu / HUD / screen layout (this sprint's primary surface). Manual walkthrough doc OR interaction test; ADVISORY gate, but Sprint 14 elevates screenshot evidence for layout stories to a **BLOCKING expert-UI-designer sign-off** because the deliverable is layout/composition correctness across viewports.
- **Config/Data** — balance / tuning / doc-only. ADVISORY smoke check pass.

## Sprint 14 Baseline

The Sprint 13 close-out baseline is the source-of-truth regression baseline for Sprint 14:

| Metric | Sprint 13 close-out baseline | Source |
|--------|------------------------------|--------|
| `cargo fmt --check` | PASS (exit 0) | Sprint 13 close-out (PROMPT 894 disposition `closed-with-conditions` at `origin/main@466d3d4`) |
| `cargo check --workspace` | PASS | same |
| `cargo test --workspace --tests --no-fail-fast` | Functional total green at Sprint 13 close-out; no new undocumented `#[ignore]` introduced | `sprint_13_closeout:` block in `production/sprint-status.yaml` |
| Workspace ignored count | **0** (preserved through Sprint 13 close-out) | same |

Sprint 14 close-out target: workspace ignored count remains at **0** unless a Sprint 14 row introduces a *documented* `#[ignore]` with owner-named disposition (the most likely candidate is story 005 viewport-invariant test bin's three negative tests for synthesized overlap / clipping / drift, which AC9 explicitly **excludes** from the `#[ignore]` count via the dedicated-negative-test exception).

**Any new undocumented `#[ignore]` marker introduced during Sprint 14 is a regression and blocks `/team-qa`.**

### No-Full-Workspace-Tests-By-Default Policy

Workers running `/dev-story` on a single Sprint 14 row MUST run the **narrowest BLOCKING command** for that row (e.g. `cargo test -p client --test ui_viewport_invariants_test` for story 005; `cargo test -p client --no-fail-fast` for HUD / lobby / shop-auction layout rows) plus nearby regression sets relevant to the changed surface. **Full workspace `cargo test --workspace --tests --no-fail-fast` is deferred to Sprint 14 end-of-sprint integration smoke** (mirrors the Sprint 13 QA-plan binding policy applied by PROMPT 833 / 844 / 884 / 891 closure verdicts).

### Cargo Resource Policy on Windows/MSVC (Binding for all Sprint 14 Cargo invocations)

All Sprint 14 `cargo fmt` / `cargo check` / `cargo test` / `cargo build` invocations on Windows/MSVC MUST set the following environment variables to avoid PDB / disk-pressure issues observed in Sprints 11-13 (binding precedent from PROMPT 815 disk-pressure incident; preserved across PROMPT 833 / 844 / 851 / 872 / 884 / 889 worker policies):

```text
CARGO_TARGET_DIR=D:\_DEV\cargo-target\ccgs-msvc
CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0
CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0
CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0
RUSTFLAGS=-C debuginfo=0 -C link-arg=/DEBUG:NONE
```

Workers MAY clear `D:\_DEV\cargo-target\ccgs-msvc\` between invocations if disk pressure exceeds threshold; cleanup authorisation is implicit in this plan.

## Bevy 0.18 UI Constraints & Responsive Layout Expectations

Sprint 14 lands all UI changes on **Bevy 0.18** (project pinned 2026-04-28 per `docs/engine-reference/bevy/VERSION.md`). Workers MUST activate the `liv-bevy-018` skill on every `.rs` file change touching `bevy` (`client/src/`, `tests/integration/`).

### Bevy 0.18 API binding (all UI layout rows)

The following Bevy 0.18 API patterns are BLOCKING for every Sprint 14 UI story:

- **Required Components API** (introduced 0.15, refined through 0.18): bundles like `NodeBundle`, `TextBundle`, `ImageBundle`, `ButtonBundle` are **deprecated**. Use the `Node` component plus Required Components (e.g. `Node` requires `ComputedNode`, `ComputedNodeTarget`, `GlobalZIndex`-equivalent). The `liv-bevy-018` skill enforces this.
- **`LineHeight` required component** (introduced 0.18): every `Text` spawn that controls vertical rhythm declares `LineHeight` explicitly; story 003 typography module exports the canonical `LINE_HEIGHT_DEFAULT_RATIO`.
- **`RenderTarget` required component** (introduced 0.18): viewport-invariant test bin (story 005) MUST spawn cameras with `RenderTarget` explicit; the helper module `tests/integration/helpers/ui_viewport.rs` encapsulates the `RenderTarget` setup.
- **`UiImage` → `ImageNode` migration** (introduced 0.16): all `client/src/ui/` image consumers use `ImageNode`. The opponent-figurine `ImageNode` (story 017) is the canonical example.
- **`Query::single()` returns `Result`** (introduced 0.16): every HUD / lobby / shop-auction system that previously used `query.single()` now propagates the `Result` with `?` or explicit `Ok(_)` match; **no `unwrap()` in production paths** per technical preferences.
- **Event → Message split** (introduced 0.16, formalised 0.17): if any Sprint 14 row touches event types it uses `Message<T>` for outbound events and `Trigger<T>` for observers per `liv-bevy-018` guidance. (Sprint 14 layout rows are mostly read-only over state; this rule applies if any row needs a new outbound signal.)
- **`ChildOf` replaces `Parent`** (introduced 0.16): every reparent operation in HUD strip migrations (stories 015, 016, 017) uses `ChildOf` not deprecated `Parent`.
- **`despawn_recursive` → `despawn`** (introduced 0.16): lobby rebuild (`OnExit/OnEnter ClientState::Lobby`) uses `despawn` with implicit recursion per 0.18 default; story 026 button-dimensions test re-spawn relies on this.
- **`Event::write()` replaces `Event::send()`** (introduced 0.16): if any Sprint 14 row sends an event, it uses `write()`.

### Lightyear 0.26 binding (any networking-adjacent row)

Sprint 14 is primarily a presentation-layer sprint, but rows that read drained protocol messages (stories 015 HUD top phase/timer, 017 HUD opp figurine, 024 lobby modal status, 025 lobby class-picker) MUST follow:

- **No client-side optimistic authority** (ADR-002 + ADR-008 binding; reinforced by Sprint 12 story 013 fallback-path precedent and Sprint 13 story 022 `S11-HU-PHASE-IDEMPOTENCY-001` closure).
- **`MessageReceiver<T>` drain pattern** for `S2CPhaseChanged`, `S2CClassLocked`, `S2CRoomReady`, `S2CGameSnapshot`. **No new parallel drain** added by any Sprint 14 row; all rows reuse the existing `client/src/network/` drain entry points.
- **Worker activates `liv-bevy-lightyear`** on any `.rs` file importing `lightyear` (verify against story file dependencies).

### Responsive layout expectations

Sprint 14 establishes the **friend-game responsive matrix** that all Tier 1+ rows MUST honour:

| Viewport size | Aspect | Required by | Notes |
|---------------|--------|-------------|-------|
| 1366×768 | 16:9 | All Tier 1 + Tier 1-adjacent rows | Minimum supported viewport per AC4 across stories 015/016/017/018/024/025/026/etc. |
| 1920×1080 | 16:9 | All Tier 1 + Tier 1-adjacent rows | Canonical desktop viewport per AC3/AC5 across stories. |
| 1920×1200 | 16:10 | Story 005 viewport-invariant test bin | Determinism check. |
| 1280×960 | 4:3 | Story 005 viewport-invariant test bin + story 004 flex strips AC6 | 4:3 stable-dimension check. |
| 3840×2160 | 16:9 | Story 005 viewport-invariant test bin | 4K determinism check. |
| 2560×1080 | 21:9 | Story 005 viewport-invariant test bin | Ultrawide determinism check. |

**Friend-game scope only**: this matrix establishes minimum-viable responsive behaviour for the friend-game route. It does NOT advance Standard-tier responsive accessibility (QA-COND-0005 accepted-risk).

### Read-only-over-server-authoritative-state invariant

All Sprint 14 Tier 1 + Tier 1-adjacent rows are **read-only over server-authoritative state** (ADR-002 + ADR-008 + ADR-012 + ADR-019 + ADR-021 binding). No row writes to authoritative state from a presentation system. Workers MUST verify:

- HUD systems read `S2CPhaseChanged` / `S2CGoldChanged` / `S2CGameSnapshot` drain frames only.
- Lobby systems read `S2CClassLocked` / `S2CRoomReady` drain frames only; **no client-side class-lock authority added** (reinforced by Sprint 12 story 013 + Sprint 13 story 023 precedent).
- Auction / shop systems read the shared auction-state resource only via `StateSync` set; **no parallel `MessageReceiver` drain added** for state visuals (e.g. story 018 lead-loss state).
- Draft systems read draft offering state; `C2SPurchaseCard` / `C2SSignalReady` send paths preserved (story 015 AC7).
